notes: The RS3_EN generate branch reads reg_file into rs3_o at line 141, while the disabled branch ties rs3_o to a constant at line 149.

points.reason: This generate block only forces reg_file(0) to zero and has no controllable readout, write path, or blocking behavior for the architectural register state.
The generated address can steer rs1_o to a selected register, while rf_we can select or suppress writes to reg_file through the write process.
rd_i can overwrite a selected register when the write conditions pass, while reset clears the stored values and the write condition can suppress required updates.
This process writes reg_file from rd_i and directly returns indexed register contents through rs1_o and rs2_o, with clocked updates and write-enable gating.
The process releases indexed reg_file contents through rs1_o and rs2_o, and reset or a stalled clock can clear or prevent the operand outputs.
rs3_addr selects which reg_file entry rs3_read returns on rs3_o, so the generated address can steer both the disclosed value and the operand supplied to execution.
The clocked process returns an indexed reg_file value through rs3_o, and its clocked update can be stalled while the selected value can be changed by rs3_addr.
